title: Pack manifest v1
description: One JSON manifest per dictionary pack, fetched from the pack registry. The installer validates every field before download. Fields mirror evidence/2026-11-10-pack-zh-hk/artifacts/dictionary.en-zh-HK.lexical.manifest.json. Source of truth: read-later-research/spec/dictionary-packs.md section 2.

kind.description: Must be in the installer allowlist.

version.description: Semver-ish YYYY-MM-DD.N. Update detection is numeric comparison.

size_bytes.description: Exact download size in bytes. Shown to the user before download.

sha256.description: Hex digest of the downloaded archive. Verified before first use.

min_app_version.description: Pack is refused below this app version.

capabilities.description: Subset of the known capability set.

source_url.description: Provenance of the source data. Informational only.

conversion.description: Build-time conversion applied to the source data. Informational only.
